info.title: Recoup API - YouTube
info.description: API documentation for the Recoup platform - an AI agent platform for the music industry

get.description: Fetches the YouTube channel summary for an artist using their stored OAuth tokens. Returns the channel's snippet, statistics, and branding fields. The response always uses HTTP 200 (errors are surfaced via the `tokenStatus` field) except for missing-parameter requests, which return 400.

parameters.name: artist_account_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the artist account whose YouTube channel info should be fetched

200.description: Channel info request processed. Inspect `tokenStatus` to distinguish success from token/API failures.

success.description: Whether the channel data was fetched successfully

channels.description: Array of channels owned by the authenticated artist, or null when the request failed

tokenStatus.description: Status of the OAuth token check and downstream call. `valid` indicates a successful response; other values indicate why channel data is null.

error.description: Human-readable error message (only present when `success` is false)

details.description: Additional error context (only present for unexpected server errors)

YouTubeChannelData.description: Summary of a YouTube channel as returned by the YouTube Data API, mapped to the shape used by Recoup clients.

thumbnails.description: Thumbnail URLs at default, medium, and high resolutions

subscriberCount.description: Number of subscribers (string-encoded integer; '0' if hidden)

videoCount.description: Total number of public videos uploaded (string-encoded integer)

hiddenSubscriberCount.description: True when the channel hides its subscriber count

customUrl.description: Channel custom URL handle, if set

country.description: Two-letter country code declared by the channel, if set

publishedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the channel was created

uploadsPlaylistId.description: Playlist ID containing all of the channel's uploaded videos

branding.description: Channel branding settings (only present when branding fields are requested)

keywords.description: Channel keywords configured in YouTube Studio

defaultLanguage.description: Default language code for the channel
